## Description

New template versions add a review of systems (each symptom yes or no, unanswered stays blank) and an examination by body system (Normal, Abnormal with a note, Not examined). The consultation suggests a template from the life stage and problems: diabetes review for diabetes, antenatal for a pregnancy, paediatrics for a child and a new older-adult review (standing blood pressure, walking test, frailty, home safety) for an older adult; the doctor can change it. Released versions stay pinned on old notes. The signed note and its PDF show the structured answers in words.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An unanswered symptom or system stays blank in the signed note; nothing defaults to normal.
- [ ] **AC2.** Abnormal needs a note; Not examined is printed as such.
- [ ] **AC3.** The suggested template is tested per life stage, and the doctor's choice wins.
- [ ] **AC4.** Old notes keep their template version (fingerprint test unchanged for released versions).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
